title: Schedule of Construction Allowances for Line Extensions and New Service Construction
content:
The construction allowance is the part of a new line that Cedar Fork Electric Cooperative builds at no charge to the member. Under **Line Extensions and New Service Construction** each class of extension has one allowance basis:

- **Footage** — a stated number of feet of extension built at no charge;
- **Revenue multiple** — a stated multiple of the estimated annual revenue of the new service built at no charge;
- **None** — the class carries no construction allowance.

## Allowance by class

| Class of extension | Allowance basis | Free footage allowance | Revenue multiple allowance | Unused allowance may be moved to another project |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Permanent Residential Overhead Extension | Footage | 300 ft | 0.0 (not used) | No |
| Permanent Residential Underground Extension | Footage | 150 ft | 0.0 (not used) | No |
| Seasonal Residence Extension | None | 0 ft | 0.0 (not used) | No |
| Farm and Ranch Extension | Footage | 500 ft | 0.0 (not used) | No |
| Irrigation Well Extension | Revenue multiple | 0 ft (not used) | 2.0 times estimated annual revenue | No |
| Three-Phase Commercial Extension | Revenue multiple | 0 ft (not used) | 3.0 times estimated annual revenue | No |
| Temporary Construction Service | None | 0 ft | 0.0 (not used) | No |

Only the figure matching the class's basis is used: a footage class reads its free footage, a revenue-multiple class reads its multiple, and a class whose basis is none carries no allowance at all.

## Transferability

The last column reads No for every class. An allowance belongs to the project it was granted on; footage or revenue allowance left unused on one project is not moved to any other project of the same member.

## Points of reading (hypothetical)

- A hypothetical farm member holding a Farm and Ranch Extension project for a new home and a separate Farm and Ranch Extension project for a pivot has a 500 ft free footage allowance on each project. If the home needs only 200 ft of line, the 300 ft left over stays with the home project and is not added to the pivot project.
- A hypothetical Three-Phase Commercial Extension whose new service is estimated at a given annual revenue has an allowance of 3.0 times that revenue; an Irrigation Well Extension with the same estimated revenue has 2.0 times it.
- A Seasonal Residence Extension and a Temporary Construction Service carry no allowance.
